method: Manufacturer official 'Available Colors' sections with exact RGB HEX. For dual-color, pairs are preserved as two RGBA swatches with 0xFF alpha.
notes: Dual-color appearance needs directional/multicolor geometry; a two-color set is not a physically complete Fusion appearance.
No reflective-roughness measurements were available; silk/matte presets remain explicit estimates.
